subject: Staged PO / bridging credit lane — invoicing & net terms
messages:
From: Laura Pritchard <l.pritchard@medarc.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medarc.com
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staged PO / bridging credit lane — invoicing & net terms

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is keen to move forward with Redwood for inference across our product stack. Procurement has a few constraints we need to make sure are in scope before Legal signs a PO:

- We typically issue a single PO that spans the fiscal quarter (we'd like to split the total commitment across Oct/Nov/Dec and then a second PO for Q1). Can Redwood accept a staged PO and invoice per phase?
- AP operates on a net90 cycle for new vendors. Is there flexibility on net terms or a bridging/credit lane while our vendor onboarding finishes?
- We need invoice line-item mapping to our internal ledger — PO line numbers per milestone would be ideal.

I'm attaching our standard PO template (MedArc_PO_Template_v3.pdf) and can share the project SOW once Redwood sends an finalized one.

Would appreciate a short note on what's required from your side so we can send an amended PO to Legal.

Best,
Laura Pritchard
Procurement Manager, MedArc Solutions
procurement@medarc.com

--- Attachment: MedArc_PO_Template_v3.pdf (application/pdf) ---

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Pritchard <l.pritchard@medarc.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, procurement@medarc.com
Date: 2026-10-26T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged PO / bridging credit lane — invoicing & net terms

Hi Laura — great to hear the team is ready to move. Short answers up-front: we can support staged POs and we have a few standard patterns for net-term exceptions.

Summary proposal:
- Staged PO: Redwood can accept a multi-PO approach (Phase 1 = onboarding + pilot, Phase 2 = production capacity). We’ll map invoices to PO line items and provide a per-invoice token/usage breakdown.
- Bridging credit lane: For AP cycles that require Net90, we usually offer either (A) Net60 with a 1.5% financing surcharge for the first 3 months, or (B) first invoice as net30 with an optional 20% prepayment to cover ramp costs and then Net60 thereafter.
- Invoice cadence and labeling: request that customer include PO line numbers on each invoice header and reference the Redwood SOW id. Our Finance team requires the PO header to include: PO#, BU code, and delivery milestone label.

I've attached a working SOW and our pricing schedule so you can validate references. Ben (cc'd) — can you confirm if Net60 + 1.5% surcharge is an acceptable standard for enterprise new vendors, or do we want to offer a different structure for MedArc?

Next steps: Laura, if you can confirm which option you prefer (A or B) and whether you need Redwood to accept a single PO that is then invoiced in phases vs multiple POs, we’ll produce a short PO addendum and updated SOW for Legal.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
--- Attachments: Redwood_SOW-Oct2026.pdf (application/pdf); pricing_schedule.csv (text/csv) ---

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: l.pritchard@medarc.com, procurement@medarc.com
Date: 2026-10-26T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged PO / bridging credit lane — invoicing & net terms

Karthik — quick finance note for the thread.

We have precedent for both patterns Karthik called out. My recommended baseline for MedArc (tier: mid-enterprise, highly likely to scale) is:

1) First invoice (onboarding & pilot): Net30 with a 20% prepayment credit applied to the first invoice. This reduces credit exposure during onboarding.
2) Production invoices: Net60 standard (no surcharge) once we have confirmed production capacity and acceptance criteria.
3) Holdback / acceptance: Customers often hold 10% acceptance holdback per milestone for 30 days; we can mirror that in the PO addendum.

PO header language we prefer to see: 
- PO#: [string]
- Redwood SOW ID: RW-SOW-2026-10-<customer-code>
- Invoice label: Phase X — <milestone description>

I’m attaching a suggested CSV price schedule mapping that includes token bands and invoice mapping. If MedArc insists on Net90, we can do Net90 but will require either (i) a 2.5% early payment discount option or (ii) an irrevocable letter of credit for the first two invoices.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
--- Attachment: pricing_schedule.csv (text/csv) ---

From: Laura Pritchard <l.pritchard@medarc.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medarc.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-27T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged PO / bridging credit lane — invoicing & net terms

Thanks Karthik / Ben — that helps. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can do the staged PO approach (Phase 1 = Oct/Nov; Phase 2 = Jan+). We will likely issue two POs (one per quarter) but need Redwood to map invoices to the PO line numbers as discussed.
- Regarding terms: our AP team prefers Net90 for onboarding vendors. However, given the ramp, we are willing to accept Option B (first invoice net30 with 20% prepayment) and Net60 thereafter as Ben suggested.
- For the holdback, we will accept a 10% acceptance hold retained for 30 days after milestone sign-off.

Action items for Redwood: please send a one-page PO addendum (explicitly stating PO labeling, milestone invoice mapping, and the net30-first-invoice / net60 subsequent terms), plus a final SOW we can attach to both POs. Once Legal has the SOW + PO addendum we’ll circulate for signature.

I’ll route the two PO numbers once Legal generates them. Expect them in the next 48 hours.

Best,
Laura
--- Note: MedArc will attach the finalized PO to this thread once Legal approves. ---

Subject: Re: Staged PO / bridging credit lane — invoicing & net terms

Laura — perfect, thanks for the confirmation and for being flexible. Per your request, attached is a short PO addendum + the final SOW. Key points we captured:

- PO mapping: Redwood will map invoices to PO line items; invoices must include PO# and Phase label.
- Payment terms: First invoice (onboarding + pilot) = Net30 with 20% prepayment applied to invoice. Subsequent production invoices = Net60.
- Holdback: 10% acceptance holdback per milestone, released 30 days after sign-off.
- If MedArc issues Net90 as the default PO term, Redwood requires either the agreed prepayment for onboarding or a signed irrevocable LOC for first two invoices (Ben flagged this as a fallback).
